title: Cerebus Jaka's Story 11 July #124 Aardvark-Vanaheim Comic Book - Dave Sim
descriptionText:
This is a rare and vintage issue of Cerebus Jaka's Story 11, published by Aardvark-Vanaheim in July 1989. The comic book features the work of various artists and writers, including the legendary Dave Sim. It is a single issue, boarded for preservation, and part of the Modern Age era of US comics.

The comic book is in excellent shape and a great addition to any collector's stash. It features the character Cerebus and falls under the genre of comics. The issue number is 11 and it is a must-have for fans of the series.
